text:
Ana V: Heads-up — Sunnova Energy renewal is coming up. They've requested to reduce seat count from 120 -> 80 and split payment across three POs to match project budgets. Need to confirm proration and invoicing flow.
Tom R: ok. Do we have their current renewal date and term?
Ana V: Current term ends 2026-04-30. They want to move to a 12-mo term but start the new term on 2026-06-01 to align with fiscal year. They asked for a 1-month credit for gap.
Priya K: 1-month gap credit is doable. Finance will calculate a pro rata credit for unused days and apply it as a credit memo. We'll need explicit PO numbers and vendor code to proceed.
Ethan L: From enablement: reducing seats is fine but we'll need the list of unassigned users to reclaim licenses and run the re-onboarding for the 80 active seats. Expect ~48 hours to process in the console.
Ana V: Action items: 1) request PO1/PO2/PO3 from Sunnova 2) get vendor code 3) confirm Net30 vs Net45 4) send amendment for e-sign.
Tom R: tagging procurement contact — @sunnova-procurement can you provide the three PO numbers and vendor code? Also confirm billing email.
Ana V: Customer replied in thread: "POs coming from three internal projects; prefer Net30; billing@contracts.sunnova.com"
Priya K: Net30 is standard. We'll set invoice terms Net30 and include PO numbers on each invoice. Also flag that three invoices will be required to map to each PO.
Ana V: They sent preliminary PO refs in email: 
```
PO-ATL: SUN-2026-ATL-998
PO-SUNGRID: SUN-2026-SG-999
PO-OPS: SUN-2026-OPS-1000
```
Ethan L: Great. Are they okay with HelloSign or do they want another provider?
Ana V: They specifically asked for HelloSign (procurement policy).
hs-bot: HelloSign envelope created: Amendment v3 (seats 80, term start 2026-06-01, 12mo). Envelope ID: HS-554321. Link: https://hellosign.example.com/e/HS-554321
Ana V: Sent HelloSign link to their legal. Also noted they retained our standard indemnity paragraph with no changes.
Tom R: Finance note — since three POs, generate three invoices covering the proportional seat allocation. If one PO arrives late, finance can issue a bridge invoice for the received PO(s) only. Need to set renewal risk to medium until all POs + signed amendment are in.
Priya K: I'll prepare the prorated credit memo logic: credit = unused days * (seat unit price * remaining seats). Will need exact seat unit price and effective cutoff date.
Ana V: Seat unit price unchanged per amendment. I'll pull price per seat from SF and add to the amendment.
Ethan L: Schedule: once HelloSign is signed and POs uploaded, enablement needs 2 business days to reclaim seats and invite new list. Can we aim for turnaround within 5 business days?
Tom R: sounds reasonable. If PO-SUNGRID delays >7 business days, finance to trigger partial billing plan and we escalate renewal risk to high.
Ana V: Uploading this thread to Salesforce and marking tasks for finance and enablement. I'll post updates here. :white_check_mark:
Ana V: Update — PO-ATL and PO-OPS uploaded. PO-SUNGRID pending (they said it's routed through corporate approvals).
Priya K: Received PO-OPS and PO-ATL in billing portal, validating numbers. If PO-SUNGRID delays, I'll prepare a bridge invoice for 40 seats (split proportionally) and notify customer.
Tom R: Thanks. Can sales ops temporarily mark the account as "at-risk" until full PO set + signed amendment?
Ana V: Doing that now in SF.
Ana V: Final note — customer asked if we can backdate the amendment to 2026-06-01 once signed. Legal confirmed that's OK as long as signature occurs within 30 days of execution.
Ana V: Will update when HS-554321 is signed or when PO-SUNGRID arrives.
